messages:
Priya: FYI onboarding webhook deliveries to customers in eu-central have been intermittently timing out between 11:42-11:52 UTC. Seeing elevated 504s and subsequent onboarding step failures. Impact estimate ~95 tenant onboarding attempts across trials and paid evals. Need comms and a mitigation + credit approach.

Noah: I'm tracing retries and backoff. Early signal looks like a downstream proxy thread saturation after a traffic shift at 11:40. Rolling restart of the proxy pool reduced error rate at 11:50.

Ethan: Can we get a quick segmentation of impacted tenants by revenue tier and by onboarding stage? I can draft AE-level notes for churn-risk ones.

Priya: Yes — uploading list to incident drive and adding columns for revenue_tier, onboarding_stage, error_count. Link: https://drive.redwood/incident/3471234567/webhook_impacted.csv

Sophie: Recommendation on credits: rather than flat amounts, propose formula = min($1,000, 0.5% * monthly committed spend) for paid evals; trials get a 21-day extension + $150 credit. Also offer an optional free migration consult for customers who hit the critical path during onboarding. Thoughts?

Jules: +1 to consult offer. For renewal-risk detection, flag any tenant where onboarding failed twice or AE reports frustration. We'll open a renewal-risk ticket and offer targeted outreach.

Ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1932 logged  Severity: P2  https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-1932

Noah: RCA short note: proxy thread pool didn't respect new connection-timeout default after a config push. Under a brief traffic spike, threads hit exhaustion -> request hang -> 504s. Mitigation: reverted config and increased thread cap; add pre-deploy load simulation for proxy changes. Full RCA to follow.

Priya: I drafted a short customer notice for CS broadcast (keeps it light, actionable):
"We experienced intermittent webhook timeouts in eu-central affecting some onboarding flows between 11:40-11:52 UTC. We reverted the change and the issue is resolved. We apologize for the interruption. We've applied a one-time credit and extended affected trials; your AE will reach out if you were in a paid evaluation. If you need immediate help, reply or email support@redwood.ai."

Ethan: Please add the region and a one-click link to a status entry. Also include a CTA for customers who still see failures to open a ticket with logs. I'll adapt for AEs.

Sophie: I'll translate and provide FR/DE localized versions and prepare a short Slack DM template for AE use.

Jules: For high-risk tenants (revenue_tier = enterprise) recommend: 1) Personalized AE outreach within 3 hours, 2) Offer a 30-min technical call + $500 credit, 3) Track NPS/renewal flags post-outreach.

Priya: Planning broadcast cadence:
- T+30m: CS broadcast email to impacted list
- T+3h: AE personalized outreach to enterprise/high-risk
- T+48h: Optional office hours for onboarding troubleshooting
- Final: Publish RCA + compensation details when RCA is finalized

Noah: I've added ae_owner to the CSV and set risk_flag where onboarding_stage = payment-setup or data-sync. Updated 11:58 UTC.

Priya: Link to tracker: https://sheets.redwood/incident-3471234567  columns: org, contact, revenue_tier, ae_owner, outreach_status, credit_amount, notes, feedback. Everyone update your assigned rows.

Ethan: Draft templates placed in folder (email_broadcast_v1, ae_message_v1, slack_dm_v1). They include variables for {{credit_amount}} and {{ae_name}}.

Sophie:  Localized drafts uploaded. Also created registration form for office hours: https://meet.redwood/office-hours/3471234567

Priya: Please confirm credit rules in tracker before broadcast. Also please :white_check_mark: the template approvals.

Jules:  I've flagged 8 enterprise tenants and left AE notes. Will follow up on outreach.

Ethan:  Templates approved, added minor wording on credit calculation.

Noah:  RCA skeleton uploaded to drive. Will fill technical timeline and remediation steps.

Priya: Action owners: Noah -> RCA details and mitigation checklist; Sophie -> localization + office hours; Ethan -> AE outreach copy and renewal-risk list; Jules -> prioritize enterprise reachout. I'll send broadcast after approvals and tracker updates.

Priya: Final ask  capture any customer feedback in the tracker 'feedback' column and mark renewal-risk = yes if AE hears cancellation intent. We'll run a daily short sync until this is resolved.

Sophie: Thanks team, will plate the localized emails and DM copy.

Priya: Posting broadcast in 25m.
